title: TAPPaaS Shares
description: config/shares.json — the Site's storage shares (ADR-029 v0.9 D4, D18). Site state, written only by storage-manager; never part of a module's release merge. A section per protocol: nfs now. An absent file is an empty one.

shares.description: NFS shares keyed by their Site-unique name; each is reached as nfs-<name>.mgmt.internal (D2b).

server.description: The module instance that carries the share: a managed Host whose module ships the NFS server hook (D19), or a registered, unmanaged server (D2a). Immutable in place — a move is a data migration.

pool.description: Managed Host: the ZFS pool the dataset <pool>/tappaas-nfs/<name> is built in. Immutable in place.

properties.description: Managed Host: ZFS properties TAPPaaS sets.

backup.description: Managed Host: whether the share is backed up (D9) — required, never a default.

owner.description: Managed Host: the uid/gid every client is squashed to, allocated by 'share add' from 64000-64999 (D5). Immutable.

grants.description: Consumer instance → access. Changed by 'nfs grant' / 'nfs revoke'.

path.description: Registered, unmanaged server: the exported path.

v3Ports.description: Registered server on NFSv3: its pinned ports, for the derived firewall rule.
